name: Do I need to be home during the exterior painting process?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to be home during the exterior painting process?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it is not strictly necessary for you to be home every day during exterior painting, it is beneficial for initial consultations, color approvals, and final walk-throughs. Our coordination service ensures that our team can access the necessary areas while respecting your privacy. A practical tradeoff is that being available for periodic check-ins or questions can streamline decision-making and ensure the project aligns perfectly with your expectations without causing delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: You don't need to be home daily, but presence for consultations and approvals helps. Being available for check-ins can streamline decisions.
